svg.title: A mountain outside. Four cities turning inside.
svg.desc: A peeled side cutaway shows four rotating habitation rotors inside the stationary outer shield. A stationary spine passes through their hubs to Ehricke, the shipyard and the port. The first two rotors turn opposite to the last two. The shield is separate from the pressure vessels.
svg.text: A mountain outside. Four cities turning inside.
Axial positions follow the model; the peeled shell and internal details are schematic.
Stationary spine: the shared route through every rotor
